options.name: base_directory
options.description: The base directory under which all container directories will be managed. The module will ensure this directory exists before processing child directories.

options.name: container
options.description: A list of container directory names or relative paths to be created under C(base_directory). Each entry represents one container directory.

options.name: group
options.description: The group to assign to created directories. If omitted, group ownership remains unchanged.

options.name: mode
options.description: The permission mode to apply to created directories, expressed as an octal string (e.g., C(0755)). If omitted, defaults to the system umask.

options.name: owner
options.description: The owner to assign to created directories. If omitted, ownership remains unchanged.
